plan.notes: Source: official Temple University Undergraduate Bulletin, 'Computer Science BS' program page (ST-CSCI-BS, Main campus): https://bulletin.temple.edu/undergraduate/science-technology/computer-science-bs/ . Catalog year verified on the page: 'These requirements are for students who matriculated in academic year 2026-2027.' Transcription method: manual transcription of the official 'Suggested Plan for New Students Starting in the 2026-2027 Academic Year' Plan of Study Grid, read term by term from the bulletin page on 2026-09-30. All course names and credit hours are from the official grid. Published term totals: Fall Y1 15, Spring Y1 15, Fall Y2 16, Spring Y2 16, Fall Y3 16, Spring Y3 15, Fall Y4 15, Spring Y4 15; sum = 123, which equals the catalog's published degree minimum of 123 total s.h. — no discrepancy. Three printed ranges were resolved to fixed values that preserve the official term totals: (a) Year 3 Fall 'GenEd Breadth Course 3-4' + 'Elective 1-0' recorded as 3 + 1; (b) Year 4 Spring 'Computer Science Elective 3-4' + 'Elective 3-2' recorded as 3 + 3. Honors alternatives (e.g. MATH 1941, CIS 1968, IH 0951) are documented in choice_note fields; the non-honors code is the slot code. Laboratory Science A and B must come from the same department (official footnote 5); options shown are representative — the full Biology/Chemistry/EES/Physics sequences are on the bulletin page. Capstone: CIS 4397 requires GPA/other registration criteria (official footnote 1). The official plan grid does not print prerequisite chains, so prereq fields are left empty rather than inferred.
